_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Ibrahim Yusuf
about_me: I'm Ibrahim, a public health PhD student in Prof. Farah Siddiqui's lab studying food access in Detroit. I need grocery or delivery data partners. I can offer analysis help to community groups.
goals: Get a data-sharing agreement for the food-access study

debriefs.text: Prof. Farah Siddiqui, my advisor, wants the data agreement signed by February. She said Domino's once shared delivery data with a university.
Met Julia Brennan from Grown Together Detroit. Her gardens supply two food pantries and she'll share distribution logs.
Talked to Mei Tanaka, data scientist at Domino's. She said a data agreement would need legal review but she'd ask.
Rosa Martinez, community organizer in Southwest Detroit, offered to help recruit families for interviews.
